model.summary: baidu/ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT (ernie4_5_moe, qwen2_moe): 27/28 MoE layers, E=64 H=2560 I=1536, top-6; 20.38B expert + 1.44B dense params

performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

reasons: experts4bit: kernel paged_graphs not usable here: the fused FP8 KV append casts to e4m3 in Triton, which needs sm_89+; this device is sm_86
experts4bit: vram_gb sized to 4.554, the largest the device budget allows
experts4bit: dram_gb sized to 10.678, the largest the host budget allows

experts split across tiers (placement solver): 4.55 GiB in VRAM, 6.13 GiB in DRAM (computed on the CPU), 0.00 GiB on NVMe (streamed through the cold tier); all-VRAM needs 17.47 GiB + headroom, over the 10.65 GiB budget

tier budgets: VRAM filled to the device budget, then DRAM to the host budget less its headroom (E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB / E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB); routing is assumed uniform, as serve_paged runs the solver without a profile

cold tier: hot_rows 1, the fewest the split can serve with (a cold layer's routed experts per step); its pinned landing, cold view and setup tier scale with it, so the server's default of 64 would cost host memory the DRAM tier can use
kernels: grouped-nf4-gemm's native CPU kernels (the solver's DRAM tier computes on the CPU)
KV pool 0.47 GiB for 4 sequences x 4096 tokens; it scales linearly in both

kernels: paged FP8 KV pool + attention, f32 compute (fp8 compute needs sm_89+, fp8_paged_attn.fp8_compute_unsupported); grouped NF4 / int4 decode routes as serve_paged resolves them (reported at /health)

first-chunk prefill graph off (the server's default is auto): its private pool is not priced (SC2b measured +3.3 GiB at Qwen3-30B), so the plan's memory would not bound the process; fix prefill_graph=auto to let the server engage it when that much is free
int4 levers off: exp_int4 and attn_int4 change the served weights (round-to-nearest int4), so the planner prices them only when fixed
not planned yet: a measured routing profile for the solver, decode speed

to serve it: E4B_PAGED_BUCKETS=1,2,4 E4B_PAGED_CHUNK_TOKENS=512 E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB=10.678 E4B_PAGED_GRAPHS=0 E4B_PAGED_HOT_ROWS=1 E4B_PAGED_KV_GROUPS=auto E4B_PAGED_MAX_SEQS=4 E4B_PAGED_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SEQ=4096 E4B_PAGED_PLACEMENT=solver E4B_PAGED_PREFILL_GRAPH=0 E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB=4.554 E4B_SERVE_ATTN_INT4=0 E4B_SERVE_EXP_INT4=0 python -m experts4bit_qlora.serve_paged (with the model's arena and calibration)
